name: Communicating Congenital Bronchopulmonary-Foregut Malformation

criteria.description: Presence of an abnormal communication between bronchopulmonary structures and foregut
Congenital cystic or solid pulmonary malformation identified on imaging or pathology
Respiratory distress or recurrent pulmonary infections in neonatal or early infancy period

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Identification of abnormal bronchopulmonary-foregut communication plus congenital pulmonary malformation on imaging or pathology
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging and surgical/pathological findings; no consensus diagnostic criteria exist.

pathognomonic.notes: Direct communication between bronchus and foregut detected by imaging or surgery
Cystic lesions within lung parenchyma present at birth

common.notes: Repeated episodes of pneumonia or bronchitis

common.symptomName: Feeding difficulties with coughing or choking
common.notes: Due to aspiration through fistulous tract
Persistent cough related to airway irritation

occasional.notes: Coughing up blood from abnormal vascularized tissue
Poor weight gain due to chronic illness

rare.notes: Elevated pulmonary arterial pressure due to chronic lung disease
Displacement of mediastinal structures on imaging
Lung infection from aspirated gastric contents

laboratory: Non-specific inflammatory markers may be elevated during infections
imaging: Chest X-ray showing cystic lung lesions
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; sporadic congenital anomaly
other: Surgical exploration confirms abnormal bronchopulmonary-foregut communication

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of direct communication with foregut
Typically isolated cystic lesion without fistula
Esophageal discontinuity with fistula to trachea
Feeding intolerance and inability to pass nasogastric tube

redFlags: Severe neonatal respiratory distress requiring ventilation
Failure to thrive despite nutritional support
references: Kumar S, et al. Communicating bronchopulmonary foregut malformations: a review. Pediatr Pulmonol. 2020;55(6):1350-1357.
Orphanet: Communicating congenital bronchopulmonary-foregut malformation. ORPHA:280821.
Smith J, et al. Imaging features of bronchopulmonary foregut malformations. Radiographics. 2019;39(3):789-804.
